name: Center for AI Safety (CAIS)
quote: Mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority
note: Organized the May 2023 Statement on AI Risk. Separate c4 sibling: CAIS Action Fund.

name: Future of Life Institute (FLI)
quote: AI experts rate leading AI companies on key safety and security domains.
note: Meets both prongs: AI Safety Index (latest Summer 2026); 2023 pause letter ('Should we risk loss of control of our civilization?'); 2025 Statement on Superintelligence (superintelligence-statement.org). Also a major funder.

name: Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI)
quote: The default consequence of the creation of artificial superintelligence (ASI) is human extinction.
note: Quote is 14 words. Book 'If Anyone Builds It, Everyone Dies' promoted at ifanyonebuildsit.com.

name: SaferAI
quote: We rate frontier AI companies' risk management practices.
note: Ratings live on subdomain tracker.safer-ai.org (ratings.safer-ai.org redirects there). Paris-based.

name: AI Lab Watch
quote: I track what AI companies are doing in terms of safety.
note: Run by one person (Zach Stein-Perlman), not an incorporated org. Site says: 'I stopped maintaining this website in September 2025.' Dormant; scorecard still public. HQ assumed US.

name: The Midas Project
quote: The Seoul Tracker evaluates sixteen leading AI companies
note: Seoul Commitment Tracker (Feb 2025) gives letter grades B- to F. Also co-published The OpenAI Files (2025). Founder Tyler Johnston.

name: ControlAI
quote: If superintelligent AI is developed anywhere, this could cause the extinction of the human race.
note: Quote is 15 words; trim to 'this could cause the extinction of the human race' if needed. controlai.com 302-redirects to controlai.org (check both). London-based.

name: PauseAI (Global)
quote: Mitigating the risk of extinction from AI should be a global priority
note: Legal entity Stichting PauseAI (Dutch foundation, KvK 92951031). The xrisk page cites the CAIS statement; an institutional page and campaign, but the quoted wording originates with CAIS. National chapters are separate legal entities.

name: PauseAI US
quote: a majority of Americans understood the risk of human extinction from AI
note: Separate 501(c)(3) incorporated 2024; ED Holly Elmore. Independent of PauseAI Global.

name: Redwood Research
quote: a bedrock approach for mitigating catastrophic risk from misaligned AI
note: Research org rather than public campaigner; qualifies via site framing of catastrophic risk from misaligned AI. Berkeley.

name: Alignment Research Center (ARC)
quote: align future machine learning systems with human interests
note: BORDERLINE: no organizational catastrophic/extinction warning found on its site; the concern is mostly in founder Paul Christiano's personal writing. Its evals team spun out as METR (Dec 2023). Author to decide.

name: METR
quote: develop scientific methods to assess catastrophic risks stemming from AI systems
note: Added. Evaluator, not an advocate or rater; qualifies through its catastrophic-risk mission statement. Formerly ARC Evals.

name: Centre for the Governance of AI (GovAI)
quote: could lead to capabilities that pose extreme risks
note: Qualifies through a co-authored paper (lead: Google DeepMind; co-author: GovAI's Ben Garfinkel) hosted on GovAI's site. The site describes GovAI as a US 501(c)(3) with a UK subsidiary; staff historically Oxford/London. HQ listed as GB, but US is also defensible.

name: Institute for AI Policy and Strategy (IAPS)
quote: an irreversible loss of human control over autonomous AI systems
note: BORDERLINE: quote is from a Science consensus paper (Bengio, Hinton et al.) with one IAPS co-author, which IAPS reposts. It is not strictly an IAPS publication. IAPS's own mission text is milder ('immense opportunities and complex challenges').

name: Centre for Long-Term Resilience (CLTR)
quote: AI loss of control incidents are worsening
note: Report title (Aug 2026). Mission: 'transform global resilience to extreme risks'. Runs a Loss of Control Observatory. London.

name: Centre for the Study of Existential Risk (CSER)
quote: We aim to reduce the risk of human extinction or civilizational collapse.
note: Added. Part of the University of Cambridge but on its own domain, cser.ac.uk (not cam.ac.uk). AI is one of several risk areas.

name: AI Futures Project
quote: Agent-4 is adversarially misaligned
note: Publishes the AI 2027 scenario (ai-2027.com), whose ending depicts misaligned-AI takeover. ai-futures.org redirects to aifutures.org. Not confirmed whether it is fiscally sponsored. HQ assumed US (Berkeley).

name: Encode (formerly Encode Justice)
quote: AI could cause catastrophic risks, whether through deliberate misuse or the loss of human control.
note: Quote is 15 words; trim to 'AI could cause catastrophic risks' if needed. Also runs the AI 2030 campaign (2030.encodeai.org). HQ assumed US (DC); not stated on the page.

name: CeSIA (Centre pour la Securite de l'IA)
quote: increasingly difficult to exert meaningful human control in the coming years
note: Co-organizes the Global Call for AI Red Lines (with The Future Society and CHAI), launched at the UN General Assembly. securite-ia.fr redirects to cesia.org. The campaign has its own domain, red-lines.ai.

name: The Future Society (TFS)
quote: increasingly difficult to exert meaningful human control in the coming years
note: Added. Qualifies as co-organizer of the Global Call for AI Red Lines. Domain and HQ not independently verified (probably US, with Paris/Brussels presence).

name: Center for Human-Compatible AI (CHAI), UC Berkeley
quote: increasingly difficult to exert meaningful human control in the coming years
note: Added. Co-organizer of the Red Lines call. University center; UC Berkeley infrastructure may sit behind it. Domain not fetched.

name: Palisade Research
quote: avoid permanent disempowerment by strategic AI agents
note: Added. Publishes shutdown-resistance demonstrations aimed at the public and policymakers.

name: Existential Risk Observatory
quote: Yes RAND, AI Could Really Cause Human Extinction
note: Added. Amsterdam. Quote is the org's own blog-post title.

name: AISafety.info (Stampy)
quote: Create a superintelligent AI with the wrong goals? Your species goes extinct.
note: FISCALLY SPONSORED by Ashgro Inc (US 501(c)(3)) but has its own domain. Founded by Rob Miles; volunteer team is global.

name: Apollo Research
quote: reducing risks from scheming frontier AI
note: Added. BORDERLINE: warns of scheming and loss-of-control threats but in an evaluator voice, not public-warning language. London.

name: Conjecture
quote: the core problem of advanced AI is the control problem
note: BORDERLINE: The Compendium (thecompendium.ai, 'Humanity risks extinction...') is signed by Conjecture staff personally, with no Conjecture byline. Conjecture's own site mentions only 'potentially catastrophic downsides'. It is a for-profit company. Author to decide.

name: Center for Humane Technology
quote: exponential capability growth outpacing our ability to steer it
note: BORDERLINE: 'The AI Dilemma' (2023) cited researcher extinction-risk estimates in the talk, but its current page has no explicit catastrophic or extinction language. The org's focus is design and incentive harms. Lean exclude.

name: Coefficient Giving (formerly Open Philanthropy)
quote: loss of control, or drastic societal change could endanger human civilization
note: Renamed from Open Philanthropy; the legacy domain is openphilanthropy.org. Largest funder of this field.

name: Survival and Flourishing Fund (SFF)
quote: concerned with the long-term survival and flourishing of sentient life
note: A 'virtual fund' (DAF at Silicon Valley Community Foundation, plus Survival and Flourishing Corp), mainly funded by Jaan Tallinn. Its own text does not explicitly warn of AI extinction; it is included as a Funder for the author to decide.
